question: It’s always fun to see your story! How did you think of Emilia-tan’s words that you don’t often hear these days? Is that from Cat-sensei’s sense of things that don’t get heard anymore?
answer: There are things that the author thinks ‘You don’t hear that anymore…’, but mostly I worked very hard to think up ‘dead words that sound cute when said’. I hope I get a chance soon to use ‘Be sure to eat your fill’ that I’ve been saving for a long time.
